description: Form validation with Zod schemas and react-hook-form integration for Auth, Compose, and EditProfile pages
steps: Create src/lib/schemas.ts with Zod schemas: signupSchema (email: valid email, password: min 6 chars, name: min 1 char required), loginSchema (email: valid email, password: min 1 char), profileSchema (display_name: min 1 max 50, username: min 1 max 24 lowercase alphanumeric plus _ and ., bio: max 200 optional), composeSchema (content: max 2200 chars, must have content or media - use refine), reportSchema (reason: min 1 char required). Use zod v4 syntax since package.json has zod ^4.4.3.

Update src/pages/Auth.tsx - integrate react-hook-form with zodResolver. Use useForm with loginSchema or signupSchema depending on tab. Replace manual validation with form.handleSubmit(). Show inline error messages below each input field using form.formState.errors with red text styling.
Update src/pages/Compose.tsx - use react-hook-form with composeSchema. Validate content length and require either content or media before submit. Show character count and inline errors.
Update src/pages/EditProfile.tsx - use react-hook-form with profileSchema. Validate display_name, username format, bio length. Show inline error messages.
Style error messages consistently: text-xs text-red-400 mt-1 below the input
acceptance_criteria: Auth page shows inline errors for invalid email, short password, missing name
Compose page validates content length (max 2200) and requires content or media
EditProfile validates display_name required, username format, bio max length
All validations use Zod schemas from src/lib/schemas.ts
verification: Run: source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && cd /projects/sandbox/Parallaxai && npm run build
Run: source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && cd /projects/sandbox/Parallaxai && npm run test
